adjustments.reason: The Maharashtra Pollution Control Board ordered closure of manufacturing operations at CG Power's Waluj unit, adding regulatory and operational risk beyond the model's initial cut.
Kaynes carries a 0/100 management delivery score on promises over the last four calls and negative 3-year operating cash flow at -0.71x reported profit, warranting a smaller increase than suggested.
Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha requested cessation effective December 31, 2026 alongside the recent MD and CEO handover to Anup Bagchi, justifying a more cautious addition.
